__comment__: REFERENCE ONLY -- the app does NOT read this file. At runtime it reads (and writes) settings.json in the per-user app-data dir: Windows %APPDATA%\AcceleratedDownloaderPro\settings.json, macOS ~/Library/Application Support/AcceleratedDownloaderPro/, Linux $XDG_DATA_HOME/AcceleratedDownloaderPro/. Any key you omit there falls back to the built-in default shown here. Edit settings in the app's Settings dialog; this file just documents the shape.
